meta.title: Today.ai × Clink — Real-World Buying for a Personal Agent
meta.description: See how Clink gives Today the ability to turn a natural-language request into an approved payment and a completed real-world purchase.
meta.ogDescription: Today understands what you need. Clink connects the products, payment approval, and fulfilment required to buy it.

hero.h1: Today Can Buy What You Ask For.
hero.standfirst: Today understands what you need. Clink connects the products, payment approval, and fulfilment required to make it happen.

demo.title: See Today Complete a Real Purchase.
demo.body: A real request, a user-approved payment, and a completed merchant order—captured from start to finish.

capabilities.title: Today Can Carry the Task All the Way Through.
capabilities.body: The conversation is only the beginning. Clink gives Today a controlled path from intent to transaction to outcome.

blocks.title: From Request to the Right Choice.
blocks.body: Tell Today the outcome you want—not the exact product page. It can carry your goal, budget, preferences, and location into a choice that is ready to buy.

visual.heading: What should I find for you?
visual.prompt: Find the best option for my trip, under my budget, and available before Friday.

blocks.title: Payments Stay Within Your Boundaries.
blocks.body: Clink handles payment identity and approval while Today keeps working on the task. The purchase stays bound to the merchant, amount, and purpose you approved.

blocks.title: Today Keeps Going After Checkout.
blocks.body: A payment is not the outcome. Today can return the confirmation, fulfilment status, and next action directly in the conversation.

setup.title: Teach Your Agent to Buy.
setup.body: Connect the agent you already use to Clink through MCP. Connector setup is coming next.
setup.thenAsk: “Find the best option within my budget and complete the purchase.”

useCases.title: Ask for the Outcome. Let Today Handle the Buying.

items.title: Restock Household Essentials
items.body: Tell Today what is running low and let it find a suitable replacement within your preferences.

items.title: Find a Last-Minute Gift
items.body: Give Today the person, occasion, budget, and deadline. It can narrow the options and complete the purchase.

items.title: Get Ready for a Trip
items.body: Ask Today for the items you still need and keep the entire purchase inside one clear budget.

items.title: Replace a Broken Item
items.body: Describe what needs replacing. Today can identify the right match and arrange the next step.

items.title: Buy Within a Set Budget
items.body: Set the outcome and the maximum spend. Today searches and acts without crossing the limit you approved.

items.title: Arrange Pickup or Delivery
items.body: Today can carry your preferred location and fulfilment method from the request through confirmation.

howTo.title: You Set the Boundaries.
howTo.description: Today can move the task forward without taking control away from you.

steps.name: Tell Today What You Need
steps.text: Describe the outcome, preferences, location, and budget in the same conversation you already use with Today.

steps.name: Approve the Boundaries
steps.text: Review the merchant, amount, purpose, and payment method before the purchase is authorized through Clink.

steps.name: Get the Completed Result
steps.text: Today continues the task and returns the order confirmation and fulfilment details without seeing your full card data.

faqs.q: Does Today See My Card Details?
faqs.a: No. Clink handles payment credentials and authorization outside the conversation. Today receives only the information needed to complete your approved purchase.

faqs.q: Do I Stay in Control of Purchases?
faqs.a: Yes. You set the merchant, amount, purpose, and other limits before a payment is authorized. Today can only continue within those boundaries.

faqs.q: What Can Today Buy With Clink?
faqs.a: Today can complete purchases from commerce systems connected through Clink. Availability depends on the merchant, product, location, and fulfilment options for each request.

finalCta.title: Give Today the Power to Complete the Purchase.
finalCta.description: Connect Today to controlled payments and real-world commerce through Clink.
